prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. Describe the spatial understanding this image supports: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"rgb": "..."} with 4-6 sentences.

descriptions.rgb: The camera looks steeply downward onto an indoor floor, with a staircase and railing along the upper/right background and bundles of long metal poles, pipes, and orange pieces spread mainly to the left and in front. One crouching man is roughly 1–2 metres in front of and below the camera, facing generally toward the wearer and looking upward toward the camera in most frames. The nearest pipe ends and the bundle he holds are within his arm’s reach and extend toward the camera wearer, while the larger material pile lies about 0.3–1 metre to his left and partly behind him. Across the five frames, the viewpoint shifts slightly right and closer while the man turns his upper body and the held bundle toward the camera; by the final frame, the wearer’s hand enters from the lower foreground and is within arm’s reach of the bundle. Long poles extend partly out of view at the left and right edges, several pieces overlap and occlude one another, and the man’s lower body is partly hidden by his crouched posture and the materials.
